source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban beautification" OR "city branding" OR "urban spectacle" OR ("urban renewal" AND spectacle)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban beautification" OR "city branding" OR "urban spectacle" OR ("urban renewal" AND spectacle),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("city branding" OR "urban beautification" OR "urban spectacle" OR ("urban renewal" AND "spectacle"))
